scope: Saved main-star path deposition and public Bevy HDR review. Narrow mechanism/admission qualification; not photographic art approval, default adoption, all-tier native acceptance, isolated GPU cost or stable 60 FPS.

outcome.image_capacity: Final visible audience/close and hidden close observations: zero global dropped fragments and invalid links. Async aggregate samples are not every-frame proof or an exact-blending oracle.
outcome.pipeline_observations: Each image run records one update with global Bevy pipeline cache not ready; pipeline identity/timing are not captured. No zero-late-pipeline claim for image runs and no causal attribution to screenshots. All three separate cost runs record zero. Effect prepared_view reports Ready.

destination.name: Star path smoke
destination.capacity: next_power_of_two(main-star tier capacity * 64); explicit per-tier profiles

authoring.source_capture_budget: Maximum high-tier main-star capacity 192: two distance crossings + death per source <=576 records/tick, below existing 1024 capture cap; no hard limits raised.

material.instance: Distinct from existing smoke so density-only control hides this layer without removing simulation.
material.shape: Seeded smooth three-octave low-frequency density, elliptical radial fade, reduced high-frequency thresholding.
material.lighting: Retains wispy scene irradiance response and ambient; no new lighting implementation.

authoring.retained: Original star/rocket emitters, existing event links, parameters, point/particle light routes, cue identities, choreography/times/seeds/transforms/overrides. Root/dependency EffectIDs remapped to distinct new assets. No runtime particle loops in host.

environment.concurrency: No agent-launched builds or other native GPU probes during the sequential native windows.

controls.images: AESTRA_EXAMPLE_REPORT_IMAGES=1; enables screenshots and separate OIT aggregate scans
controls.star_hidden: AESTRA_EXAMPLE_REPORT_STAR_SMOKE=0; image-only distinct material Density=0; all 37996 births remain
controls.cost: Unset image/profile/custom-times variables; audience camera; visibility 1. Existing async admission/playback counters remain enabled.
controls.limits: Forward real-time playback, no seek/frozen replay. Screenshot delivery is asynchronous; nominal times and populations vary, so images are not exact paired pixels. OIT scans/image HUD intervals are not cost measurements.

iterations.judgment: Rejected art: coarse grain and separated beads; capacity passed.

cost_summary.interpretation: Whole-host intervals include vsync and CPU/GPU/OS scheduling; sequential dev-build observations. Variability prevents a fixed marginal overhead/speedup claim. No isolated GPU timings or stable 60 FPS acceptance.
